title: ASMR whispered science of how we know for deep sleep · when you can't sleep (2 hr)
description:
A slow, whispered walk through how people learned what they cannot touch: how far away other galaxies are, how old a shell or a stone is, how the dark sea floor was mapped, and how people reached the deepest place on Earth.
The voice is AI: a clone of the creator's own whisper, made with Chatterbox. The facts come from checked public sources.
2 hr of soft whispering over dim, slow footage of the real thing, no music.

Written for sleep from fact-checked How We Know scripts (howweknowdeep.com).

Picture credits
Der Marianen-Graben (1907 bathymetric chart): Otto Krümmel, Handbuch der Ozeanographie (1907); scan: NOAA Photo Library (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mariana_Trench_Map_1907.jpg)
